name: jspeedz/php-multiprocessor
description: Forking jobs in PHP to speed up processes

suggest.monolog/monolog: ^3.0, to lock stdout/stderr log writes across forks with Logging\Monolog\CrossProcessLockHandler
suggest.symfony/console: ^7.4 || ^8.0, to add the --lock-log-output command option with Logging\Symfony\Console\LogOutputLockOptionTrait
suggest.doctrine/dbal: ^4.0, to reset Doctrine connections before forking with Callback\Close\ResetDoctrine
suggest.doctrine/persistence: ^3.0 || ^4.0, to reset Doctrine connections before forking with Callback\Close\ResetDoctrine
